title: Regular-sequence kernels compared with a regular presentation of the completed quotient
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(Q,\mathfrak m_Q)$ be regular local rings [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m_R$ be an ideal, put $B=R/I$, and let $\widehat B=\varprojlim_n B/(\mathfrak m_RB)^n$ be its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $\pi:Q\to\widehat B$ be a surjective ring homomorphism. Then $I$ is generated by a finite $R$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_R$ if and only if $\ker\pi$ is generated by a finite $Q$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Empty generating sequences are allowed.
